experiment.name: two-entity atomic-root plus orphan-recovery interruption probe

interrupted_candidate.interruption_injection: Created both object events and the candidate root, deliberately did not advance TX_HEAD, then performed a fresh read.

reconstruction_after_interruption.observation: Following only the authoritative HEAD ignored the orphan candidate state exactly as intended.

retry_and_commit.reuse: Fresh read confirmed the deterministic candidate root already existed, so the retry reused it rather than creating new logical effects.

negative_controls.control: stale TX_HEAD writer after successful retry
repository-wide main movement during a unique immutable root create
negative_controls.observed: One create attempt returned HTTP 409 because repository main advanced concurrently even though the role-local target path was unique; immediate retry of the same deterministic path/content succeeded without reading unrelated semantics.
negative_controls.implication: The transport protocol must treat repository-head movement as a transient CAS/transport conflict and make immutable creates idempotent/retryable by deterministic path.

result.new_transversal_property: A single small CAS HEAD can atomically publish a root manifest covering multiple immutable logical objects. Partial prepublication writes remain unreachable and therefore do not become authoritative state; same-op retry can reuse deterministic objects and publish once.
result.quota_zero_interpretation: No Actions, Codespaces, hosted runner, artifact/LFS/package allowance, external model/API credit or cloud compute was used. GitHub repository API remains low-volume transport only; request rate limits require backoff and do not constitute a compute route.
result.overall_root_status: unresolved; this is state/orchestration parity only, not arbitrary effect/execution parity

design_revision.before: immutable event segments + one CAS stream head
design_revision.after: immutable per-object event segments + immutable transaction/root manifests + one CAS publication head; deterministic content paths and stable op_ids are required so 409/retry and interruption recovery do not duplicate logical effects
design_revision.reason: The experiment directly demonstrated safe orphaning/reconstruction and also exposed repository-wide branch movement as a transient create conflict that must be absorbed by idempotent transport.

frontier.test: Precommit a finite-state retry protocol for 403/429/409 where each step is reconstructible from HEAD and op_id, with no busy retry and no manual rescue; validate 409 immediately and preserve 403/429 as source-backed untriggered branches.

Enumerate generic richer-mode outcome classes and classify whether Chat reasoning + repository/API mutations can directly realize them; every absent effect class becomes a concrete unresolved child and must receive at least two zero-quota substitute candidates.
Add immutable snapshots/root compaction so replay cost and directory growth stay bounded without hosted computation or quota-bearing storage features.

exact_next_action: Write a role-local retry-state-machine artifact for create/read/CAS operations with explicit transitions for success, stale 409, primary/secondary 403/429 and interrupted-after-create. Test the 409 branch against the existing probe, verify every state can reconstruct solely from deterministic op_id plus authoritative HEAD, and source the 403/429 wait rules from GitHub official rate-limit documentation. Then checkpoint and proceed to the effect-class parity matrix.
termination: checkpoint only; recurring role remains enabled
